title: Wire commission accrual in checkout
description: Create employee_commissions entries during paid checkout based on commissionRateBps
completion: Created lib/services/commissions.ts with accrueCommission: queries employee by cashierUserId, computes commission = totalAmount * commissionRateBps / 10000, inserts pending employee_commissions with current-month period. Wired into checkout (paid orders) and confirmOrderPayment (webhook-settled online payments). Silently skips if no matching employee, inactive, or zero rate.
